description: List the user's expense reports with pagination. Filter by status (All, Draft, Submitted, Shared). Each exact report includes its app, Bill Client, and accounting handoff URLs. Use the matching accounting URL only when the user explicitly asks to send or export that report; the app keeps organization, mapping, preview, and final confirmation.

clientEmail.description: Client account email. Accountants may use this only for an accepted ExpenseBot client.

filter.description: Optional report-status filter; All returns every authorized status.

limit.description: Maximum reports to return on this page.

name: list_reports

reports.description: Present when the user has reports.
